|champion     = Olaf
|skill        = W

|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|40 to 80}}%}}

|cast time    = none
|cost         = 50
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Auto
|spelleffects =

E.name: Reckless Swing
E.title: Template:Data Olaf/Reckless Swing
E.wikitext:
<!-- Damage values are defined as parameters.
-->{{#vardefine:b1|70}}<!-- Rank 1 base damage
-->{{#vardefine:b5|250}}<!-- Rank 5 base damage
-->{{#vardefine:ad|50}}<!-- Total AD ratio as a PERCENTAGE
-->
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Reckless Swing|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Olaf
|skill        = E
|icon         = Reckless Swing.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Olaf}} consumes {{as|{{sti|health}}}} to strike thunder onto the target enemy, dealing {{as|true damage}}. If this kills the target, '''Olaf''' {{tip|heal|heals}} the {{sti|health|{{as|health cost}}}}.
|blurb2      = Basic attacks {{sti|cdr|reduce}} ''Reckless Swing's'' cooldown.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Olaf''' strikes thunder onto the target enemy, dealing {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}.
|description2 = If ''Reckless Swing'' kills the target, '''Olaf''' {{tip|heals}} himself equal to the {{as|{{sti|health|health cost}}}}.
|description3 = Basic attacks reduce ''Reckless Swing's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second, increased to 2 against monsters.
|leveling     = {{st|True Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}} to {{#var:b5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:ad}}% AD)}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|11 to 7}}
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 325
|cost         = {{as|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*0.4 to {{#var:b5}}*0.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad}}*0.4}}% AD)}}|health}}
|costtype     = {{as|Health}}
|cast time    = {{pp|0.25 to 0.175|0 to 125 by 12.5|key1=%|type='''bonus''' attack speed|color=as|round=3}}
|targeting    = Unit
|damagetype   = True
|spelleffects = spell
|affects      = Enemies
|spellshield  = True
|callforhelp  = true
|notes   = 
* The health cost is equal to 40% of ''Reckless Swing's'' {{as|true damage}} value.
* ''Reckless Swing'' can be cast even if '''Olaf''' doesn't have the sufficient amount of health to pay for the health cost.
** As with all abilities with health costs, ''Reckless Swing'' will not reduce '''Olaf's''' health below {{as|1|hp}}.
* ''Reckless Swing's'' health refund is considered a {{tip|heal}} therefore it is affected by healing modifiers.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}** '''Olaf''' will also not receive the benefits from killing an enemy if this canceling takes place very shortly before the attack hits the invalidated target, but ''Reckless Swing's'' effect will be consumed.{{bug}}
* The health cost will also be refunded if the target dies shortly after being hit by ''Reckless Swing''.
}}

R.name: Ragnarok
R.title: Template:Data Olaf/Ragnarok
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Ragnarok|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Olaf
|skill        = R
|icon         = false
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Olaf}} gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resist}}}}.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Olaf''' becomes enraged for a short time, {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself and becoming {{tip|cc-immune}}, as well as gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and increased [[size]]. For a brief moment, he gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing nearby enemy {{tip|champions}}.
|blurb3      = ''Ragnarok's'' duration can be extended by hitting [[basic attack]]s and ''{{ai|Reckless Swing|Olaf}}'' against an enemy {{tip|champion}}.
|blurb4      = {{sbc|{{tip|cc-immune|Cc-immunity|nolink=true}}}}: {{tip|Crowd control}} cannot be applied during this time.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Olaf''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Resistances|{{ap|10 to 20}}}}
|icon2        = Ragnarok.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Olaf''' becomes enraged for 3 seconds, {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself of all {{tip|crowd control}} and becoming {{tip|Cc-immune|immune to them}}, as well as gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and 10% increased [[size]]. For the first second of ''Ragnarok'', he also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} within 2000 units.
|leveling2    = {{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 25% AD)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20|45|70}}%}}
|description3 = ''Ragnarok's'' duration is increased by and up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds for each basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} or cast of ''{{ai|Reckless Swing|Olaf}}'' against an enemy {{tip|champion}}.
|cooldown     = {{ap|100 to 80}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cast time = none
|effect radius=
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = mana
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self
|notes   = 
* ''Ragnarok'' removes the underlying {{tip|stun}} from {{tip|airborne}} effects, but not the forced displacement, which requires him to use a {{tip|blink}} or {{tip|dash}} ability to override it.
* ''Ragnarok'' does not negate any [[debuff]]s other than {{tip|crowd control}} from being applied unless absolutely necessary.
* The {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} updates dynamically over the duration; Increases or reductions in {{as|attack damage}} after the effect has been applied will still be amplified.
* The {{as|25% attack damage}} scaling amplifies the flat {{as|attack damage '''bonus'''}} as well.
* ''Ragnarok'' will not expire during {{ais|Reckless Swing|Olaf}} cast time.
* ''Ragnarok's'' duration will not be increased if the basic attack is {{tip|dodged}}.
* ''Ragnarok's'' duration will be increased if the basic attack is {{tip|blocked}}.
}}
